summary: Iter 45: Tested all 6 new admin endpoints (approved/rejected/plus makers, applicant email, broadcast preview/send) and full admin UI for the 4 new tabs + slimmed Applications + BetaPage Founding Member Login CTA + Nav FOUNDING LOGIN pill. 19/19 backend pytest pass. Frontend: every spec'd data-testid renders and core flows (open email modal -> fill -> send, broadcast template -> audience -> preview -> send test) all succeed end-to-end with success toasts.
critical_code_review_comments: Spec for /admin/broadcast/preview said body needed only 'audience', but the actual endpoint requires subject+message too. The frontend flow already passes them, so no functional impact, but the API contract in the spec was slightly off. Worth aligning docs.
Broadcast templates only swap headline + subject (not message body). This matches the spec but UX-wise users may expect the body to be templated too - consider adding optional template body presets.
test_credentials: Admin JWT minted via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('admin','team@craftersmarket.org', role='admin') and stored in localStorage.cm_admin_jwt before navigating to /admin/dashboard.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing data (8 pending apps, 35 rejected, 6 approved makers, 0 plus subscribers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter45 features green. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter45_admin_lists_broadcast.py covers all 6 new endpoints. Frontend testids verified: admin-tab-{approved-makers,rejected-apps,plus-members,broadcast}, approved-makers-table, approved-filter-beta, rejected-row-*/email-*/delete-*, plus-members-table/empty, broadcast-preview-btn/box, broadcast-template-*, broadcast-audience-*, broadcast-live-btn, admin-email-modal, admin-email-send, app-email-*/delete-*, beta-founding-login-btn, nav-founding-login-btn. Beta page CTA links to /maker/login as expected. Nav FOUNDING LOGIN pill renders next to BETA SIGNUP when signed-out.
